title: Build Online Questionnaire From Synopsis
desc:
I have a written synopsis that needs to be transformed into a clear, engaging online questionnaire. The finished form should be hosted on a popular platform such as Google Forms, Typeform, Microsoft Forms, or any equivalent you are comfortable with, as long as the shareable link works seamlessly on desktop and mobile browsers.

Structure & content  
• Mix the three question styles I selected—multiple choice, short answer, and rating scale—so they flow naturally from the logic of the synopsis.  
• Design each item to capture either text responses or numerical data, as appropriate. For example, rating scales should translate to clean numeric output while open-ended prompts record text accurately.  
• Organise sections, progress indicators, and branching (if helpful) to keep respondents engaged and minimise drop-off.

Deliverables  
1. Live form link, fully tested.  
2. Editable copy of the form in its native platform.  
3. Exported response sheet template (CSV or spreadsheet) showing how the captured text and numbers map to columns.  
4. Brief note (max one page) explaining any conditional logic you applied and tips for future edits.

Success criteria  
• Every question traces back to a point in my synopsis—no gaps, no extraneous items.  
• Form loads fast and works on major browsers and phones without layout issues.  
• Exported data is clean: text fields free of leading/trailing spaces, numeric fields validated for numeric input only.

title: Instagram Content & Admin Support
desc:
I’m looking for a reliable assistant who can take the lead on creating fresh, engaging content for my Instagram account while stepping in for light digital chores when needed. The role centres on Instagram content creation, yet now and then I may ask for basic data entry or straightforward administrative follow-ups.

What I need most right now:
• Original Instagram posts: simple graphics or photos, concise captions, relevant hashtags.  
• Consistent delivery: propose a realistic posting rhythm and stick to it.  
• Clear communication: update me on progress, ask questions early, and meet agreed deadlines.  
• Flexibility: if a quick spreadsheet update or minor admin task pops up, you’re comfortable handling it.

You should be able to:
– Follow written instructions without supervision.  
– Work punctually and take ownership of the schedule you set.  
– Use basic online tools (Canva, Google Workspace, or similar) to draft and share content for approval.

Experience in social media management is welcome but not mandatory; I value responsibility and good communication even more.

When you reply, please tell me:
1. Your relevant experience (even if it’s personal projects).  
2. How many Instagram posts you can produce weekly and your estimated turnaround time.  
3. Your proposed fee or hourly rate.

I’m eager to find someone who can start quickly and grow with the role as new digital tasks arise.

title: Wireless Video & Data Acquisition Prototype
desc:
Custom Embedded Video Telemetry & Data Acquisition System

We are seeking an experienced Embedded Systems / Hardware Integration Engineer to develop a compact proof-of-concept prototype for a low-latency, point-to-point wireless video and data acquisition system.

Key Requirements:

- Custom PCB design, schematics, and hardware integration
- Digital video interface & processing (MIPI CSI / HDMI / H.264/H.265)
- Low-latency wireless transmission and RF optimization
- Firmware tuning, bitrate optimization, and power management
- Compact thermal management and NTC-based safety protection
- Li-Po power architecture with 4–5 hours target runtime
- Prototype assembly, testing, and range/stability validation

Engagement:
Phase 1 – Architecture & component feasibility consultation
Phase 2 – Functional bench prototype & testing
Phase 3 – Pre-production enclosure/hardware planning

Detailed specifications and deployment information will be shared with shortlisted candidates after NDA execution.

Please share relevant portfolio/case studies of custom embedded hardware projects taken from prototype to production.

title: Android Algebra Study App
desc:
I want to turn my high-school algebra notes into a focused Android application that learners can carry in their pocket. The app will present each topic—linear equations, quadratic functions, factoring, and so on—in a clean, distraction-free interface and keep track of how far the student has progressed through the material. The progress-tracking dashboard is the must-have feature: after every section the user should instantly see completion percentages and a simple visual indicator showing what still needs review.  

Feel free to suggest elegant ways to store that data locally or in the cloud, yet keep the first version light so it runs smoothly on typical student devices. Although practice quizzes or step-by-step solutions might be interesting future add-ons, you can ignore them for this build and focus your time on a rock-solid reading experience, intuitive navigation, and reliable progress persistence.

Deliverables  
• Full Android Studio project (Kotlin or Java) with well-commented source code  
• Signed APK ready for Play Store submission  
• Brief set-up document explaining how to update content and reset progress data  

Acceptance criteria  
• Topics load instantly, and progress bars update without glitches  
• App installs on Android 7.0 and above with no crashes during a five-minute exploratory test  
• Code passes a quick review for readability and uses standard Android architecture components

title: AI-Generated YouTube Shorts Production
desc:

Expect snappy 15-60 second clips that hook viewers in the first three seconds, keep them watching with tight storytelling, and close on a clear call-to-action.

Here’s what I need from you:
• 100 % AI-generated vertical videos (9:16) delivered in 1080 × 1920 MP4  
• Short, punchy scripts and prompts that feed the chosen AI platform smoothly  
• Captions burned in, royalty-free music, and a bold thumbnail pulled from (or designed for) each video

I’m flexible on the toolkit—Runway, Pika, Kaiber, CapCut, or any stack you know best—so long as the final Shorts are ready to upload without extra tweaks.

When you apply, focus on your experience producing AI-driven Shorts: links to previous videos, the platforms you’ve mastered, and anything else that proves you can turn around polished clips quickly.
